as_told.title: Gnostic reading that Jesus survived the crucifixion

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher of ancient history, says that Jesus did not die on the cross and that much more was going on behind the scenes, pointing to Brian Muraresku's book The Immortality Key and to Joseph of Arimathea, a follower named in the Gospels. In this telling the crucifixion was a planned ritual that Jesus survived, which would change the central story of Christianity.
